what: The golden numbers a clean install must reproduce (eir:bootstrap --fresh --with-client-inputs --build --run-engines --verify). Each value was recomputed from the database by App\Services\Eir\BaselineService::goldenActuals(); --verify recomputes it and compares, to the cent for amounts and exactly for counts.
commit: 89eda37 (stage overrides and override schedules; the bootstrap applies the committed December 2025 schedule), reproduced by a second run on the same commit
database: maiic_ifrs9_gold_a (run A); reproduced to the cent by maiic_ifrs9_gold_b (run B)
note: Set from two fresh bootstraps of the merged phase 1 (staging-governance at b64ba30) from two clean checkouts into two empty databases, run side by side on 15 October 2026: run A set the values and run B reproduced all 76 to the cent. Approved by Edward Mazibuko on 15 October 2026. 35 values move: the ECL by stage, the discounted allowance, the Mega Farm provision, the month records and the loans discounted follow single-ladder staging, now the seeded default (the 31 December 2025 policy, matured loans counted from maturity); the EIR revenue figures follow that staging too. The revenue figures also include 5647b41 (the Stage 3 interest basis follows the stage at the start of the month, and the Stage 3 history books the allowance the net basis needs), which had not reset golden.json. One golden is removed: the count of September 2026 loans not discounted because no remaining contractual horizon is available is no longer produced. The other 42 (take-on, ledger, loan books, write-offs, the RBM return, the overdue-run comparison, the compliance register, the Mega Farm ledger ties, the EIR counts) do not move. Commit 60fa8d5 (an existing database keeps the staging it ran; four review fixes) changes nothing on a fresh database.

release_set: Release of 16 October 2026 (S&P basis in the bootstrap; account exclusion register, 12 accounts confirmed by MAIIC; controls read the landing zone as received; generated schedules keep the last instalment; no automated approval of a generated schedule that differs from E-Banker's chart): 39 values moved, set from the fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_rel_c and reproduced to the cent by maiic_ifrs9_rel_d (commit 6bad3da).
reset_2026_10_17: Reset on 17 October 2026 at Edward's instruction from two fresh bootstraps of eaee4d5 into two empty databases: all 118 checks identical between the runs. 10 values are new (the client books compared with the rebuilt book and, for December 2025, the loans matched, the same and the differences of the E-Banker report and the audited model; the PD bases kept for comparison in the golden months). 23 values move, all from commits made before this build: a third fresh bootstrap of 27c1524 (origin/master before eaee4d5) reproduces every one of the 86 shared values of run A to the cent, so eaee4d5 moves none of them. The moves follow 2f98f37 and fc67d47 (the Loan Book Report point-in-time fix and its two checks: the staging day count and the arrears buckets of 393 loan-months; one December 2025 loan from Stage 2 to 3, the overdue-run comparison 229 to 227, the Stage 3 interest on the net basis and the S&P basis of September 2026) and 64aef35 (MAIIC's book one PD pool and the Mega Farm programme its own: the ECL of both golden months, the month records and the Mega Farm figures).
